name: Demo: The Gilded Ledger
description: A demo extension pack: the DDDnD monolith story retold for a fictional payments company, built on the base pack's scores, cards, and endings.

name: SRE: The Pager Storm
description: A second domain for DDDnD: site reliability engineering and incident response. Its own scores (availability, error budget, a rested on-call…), council, cards, events, endings, classes and challenge modifiers, on the base pack's outcome tiers.
